column1: # Ash Jenna reaches the party in Tolbi after Colosso.

column3: Jenna! Your hands...\nYou are turning grey.{end_wait}

It is the light. Since
the lighthouse lit, I have
been burning down.{page_break}What is left of the fire
is ash.{end_wait}
Fire is our element. It\nshould never burn us\nlike this.{end_wait}

Menardi never wanted
this. It is breaking her
too.{page_break}Please stop lighting
the lighthouses.{end_wait}
Stop? How sweet. The ash\ngirl wants us to kneel\nin the rain.{end_wait}
Mia, you know what a\nlight costs. You carry\nit in your hand.{end_wait}

If Venus Lighthouse is
lit, nothing will be left
of me.{page_break}Do not follow. I will
slip back before they
notice I am gone.{end_wait}
